title: A proposed eight-session learning plan
method: Planning allocation, not observed learning outcomes: 8 sessions × 45 minutes = 360 minutes, distributed 2/3/2/1 sessions. Completion depends on prior experience and project scope.
alt: A proposed eight-session learning plan. Setup and input: 90 minutes; Core transformation: 135 minutes; Boundary checks: 90 minutes; Run instructions: 45 minutes. Illustrative inputs.
